reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: J Balls
reviews.text: **Review for Parish Tire - Dodson County, NC** I recently had an emergency blowout on Highway 81 while traveling from New York City to my home in South Carolina, and I can't express enough gratitude for the incredible service I received at Parish Tire in Dodson County. With only 15 minutes to closing, I called the shop and spoke with Mr. Cody, who immediately went above and beyond to assist me. He quickly relayed my situation to Mr. Bradley, the manager, and assured me that they would be able to help. When I arrived, I was met with a warm welcome from Mr. Cody and Mr. Jonathan, who took my vehicle right away and replaced my blown tire with a new one. The professionalism and kindness displayed by the entire team were remarkable. They treated my family and me with the utmost respect and made a stressful situation much more manageable. It was clear that they genuinely cared about helping us, and their willingness to stay late to ensure we were safe on the road was truly commendable. I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to Mr. Bradley for waiting for us and to the entire team for their exceptional service. I will definitely be forwarding this email to your CEO, Mr. Logan Jackson, to share my appreciation for the outstanding experience. Thank you once again from the bottom of my heart! Sincerely, John Balleste

reviews.author: Mel Ross
reviews.text: Tires were on and alignment and breaks were checked and was finished with in an hour or so. They were honest with me and told me I didn’t need break shoes and the alignment was good at this time. They were very curtious and friendly. I really appreciated the honesty and I feel I have found a fair and honest place to service my car knowing they will not repair something that doesn’t need repair. I highly recommend them and will continue to take my vehicles to them for repair and tires.

reviews.author: Shannon Bogart
reviews.text: Alignment on my car, all the way around after Mavis Tire tried and failed 3 times. Cody and his team at Parrish Tire & Automotive were fast and honest. Something that Mavis Tire was not. Thank you guys for doing the job right and for your honesty.

reviews.author: Carla Matthews
reviews.text: Tyrell and Cody are always eager to help you and guide you in the right direction for you vehicle repair. The mechanics have always done a great job with my car. I appreciate them all.

reviews.author: jeffy ann
reviews.text: We had to be towed at 10 pm at night, fuel pump went out. These guys got us back on the road by the next day, despite having other obligations to fulfill also. What would we do without our mechanics!! Thank you team!

reviews.author: David Luy
reviews.text: The mechanics at Parrish Tire and Automotive at incredibly friendly, and they go above and beyond in helping their customers. We were stranded on our way home to Pittsburgh, and they stayed late at work on a Friday to get us back on the road safely. We were humbled that they were willing to do that for us. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Nancy Crouse
reviews.text: I always receive great service at Parrish Tire. Tyrell is the best when it comes to customer service. No matter if I go for an oil change, tire rotation, brake service or whatever. There is never an unexpected charge for anything. He will let me know if anything is found other than what I am there for.

reviews.author: Jimmy Corder
reviews.text: Great service. Very knowledgeable sales person. Found a tire right for me at the right price. Easy to work with.

reviews.author: Erica Lowry
reviews.text: I went in for an alignment and was worried if I had some break trouble as well, Cody was super informative and friendly! And they worked super fast! Definitely will be going back for anything else that has to do with my vehicle

reviews.author: Bryson Wood
reviews.text: Had my workout tires replaced. I figured it would take a while, but these guys got it done quickly! Very professional and courteous atmosphere

reviews.author: Jenna Lesar
reviews.text: The team here came to our rescue! We had two blown trailer tires less than 15 miles apart. We are not from the immediate area and limped for 3 miles north on I-77 to get to the exit. With 90 minutes before store closing the team lent us a jack to be able to replace the 2nd blown tire so we could drive the trailer to them and they replaced all 4 plus the spare. Amazing service and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Joseph Shores
reviews.text: Awesome job installing my 2 inch leveling struts on my 2020 Chevy Silverado! They ran into issues due to new models and new level kits needing adjustments to truly get level. They fixed the issues and kept me in the loop to make sure it was done correctly!

reviews.author: heidi roura
reviews.text: Such a great repair shop Highly recommend Tyrel! They did a great job and was back in our vehicle the same day

reviews.author: Seth Darnell
reviews.text: Just recently purchased a used Toyota 4Runner for our daughter. I wanted to make sure it was safe for her on the road. We took it to Dobson Parrish Tire and had tires, tune up and other odds and ends. Cody was and is always very professional. We are very pleased with the service we received.

reviews.author: Timothy Sherman
reviews.text: Tyrell and Cody treated my truck tire issue and me with professional care. They initially repaired my tire with a patch ($25) which didn’t hold. They even credited the $25 toward a new tire! Highly recommend this tire shop! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Marny Britt
reviews.text: I got a flat which was my own fault because I knew I needed tires but kept putting it off. Of course it happened at the worst possible time. Leaving for my much awaited weekend birthday trip at the Casino, we hadn't made it 20 miles down the highway when my right rear tire completely split and went flat. Luckily I had run flats and was able to get to an exit and into a safe place off the road. I called several very close places asking if they had my size tire, planning to drive there on the runflats if they did. No one did except Parrish, but only at their warehouse. I thought I was out of luck and would need to be towed home because I was afraid that was too far to drive on the runflats, but then they told me they have a Mobile service and they could go to the warehouse, pick up the tires and come to me to change them! I thought that was a fabulous idea but would surely cost me an arm and a leg. NOPE! The Mobile service is an incredibly reasonable $35!!! So I just decided to go ahead and have them change all 4 since I was planning to do it anyway, I'd just been too busy. Now i wouldn't have to make an appt and go back another day. Roughly 2 hours later I had 4 new tires and was on my way ! I might just do the Mobile service next time I need new tires just for the amazing convenience!!

reviews.author: Kyle Foresman
reviews.text: All the guy’s in the Dobson location have been great. I have been there twice in the past 2 months, once for a set of 4 trailer tires, Cody went the extra mile and drove to the Mt. Airy location to get a 4th tire that was needed and I was out of there with the trailer very quickly. This most recent time I had a blowout the day before, the spare was on my Yukon and the blowout was in the back, they replaced all 4 tires at my request with an oil change and put the spare back up under the vehicle. I highly recommend the Dobson location, it is a great team there!

reviews.author: Jan Lancaster
reviews.text: Parrish Tire is great. If you need your car or truck repaired, go to Parrih Tire. They stand by their work.

reviews.author: Beth Flinchum
reviews.text: They were very friendly, They got the work done in a reasonavle amount of time. Weve been doing business here for years.

reviews.author: Justin Cagle
reviews.text: Parrish tire of Dobson is the only place I'll take my business, the guys over there always do a great job and listen to any special requests that I have.

reviews.author: Tuan Kiet
reviews.text: They’re quick and efficient with their diags, we had a misfire on a 2019 Lincoln that was diagnosed and fixed within 2 hours. Their price is pretty reasonable as well, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Samantha Sebastian
reviews.text: I took my vehicle in yesterday for what I believed to be low tire pressure from weather. The men there were so kind and aired all my tires up in a few minutes. Duane let me know that it was possible my tire had a leak or a hole and told me to keep an eye on it just in case. This morning my tire pressure sensor went off again. I immediately brought my vehicle back as I now knew it did have an issue. My car was in and out in less than 2 hours for less than I anticipated having to pay. I can't thank them enough for warning me ahead of time that I may have a bigger problem. 10/10 this location and the employees are kind and efficient.

reviews.author: Shirley Simpson
reviews.text: Parrish Tire in Dobson provides excellent service. They have been so good to help me out with a flat tire. They came out to my house pumped it up so they could get it to their shop and repaired the tire. It was such a blessing to me. I didn't have to worry about how I was going to get the tire fixed. I am now a loyal customer. They are very community minded and really care about their customers.

reviews.author: Frank Casagrande
reviews.text: Blew a tire in RV on way up 77. Able to get to there shop on dually. Tyrell got us fixed up and back on the road in less than a hour. I can't say enough good things about how we were treated!

reviews.author: Jean
reviews.text: Cody and staff were quick to get my tires installed and get me back on the road. They were very courteous and treated me respectfully

reviews.author: Deb Dyer
reviews.text: This is a great place to take your car and very convenient to get to. Everyone on staff was very nice and helpful, and I was in and out quickly with a new tire and battery for my car ignition key.

reviews.author: Janice Leininger
reviews.text: They took care of what I needed. I had thought it was something completely different going on with my truck, but they found the issue and fixed it. Really good customer service. My truck is no longer under factory warranty, so there isn't any need to go to dealership when Parrish Tire is so close and they can do what i need. Thanks to Cody and the rest of the crew for taking care of what I needed

reviews.author: Kimberly Harper
reviews.text: The staff there are great. They are friendly & appreciate each customer. They do great work, they know what they’re doing. We trust Parrish Tire with our vehicles.

reviews.author: Bob Jones
reviews.text: We were just starting our 2nd day driving to FL from upstate NY and facing a 600+ mile day when our brakes failed. A local recommended Parrish Tire and Automotive and Tyrell and his team did a terrific job getting us on the road in about an hour. Tyrell recommended the coffee shop across the street for breakfast, which was great, and by the time breakfast was done, the brakes were also done, and we were on the road again. I give Parrish 5 stars for extraordinarily efficient and friendly service.

reviews.author: Pamela Davis
reviews.text: I had 2 tires that where ready to separate! The guys at Parish Tire got right on fixing it for me and the price was reasonable and they are super nice. I will be going there again for all my tires.

reviews.author: Adan Garcia
reviews.text: Cody was great to talk to, gave me a quick quote and was able to get new tires and al alignment in a fast time frame. Definitely recommended coming here.

reviews.author: Beverly Conner
reviews.text: I have had the good fortune of having Parrish Tire doing some work for me several times. I have mostly been there on a walk in basis. They have been super nice and helpful in times that I was in distress as I didn’t have anyone to help me with my transportation. Each time they had me fixed up in a jiffy! I highly recommended these fine people if you need a quick fix . They are amazing!

reviews.author: Eric Lewallen
reviews.text: Great place to take your vehicle! Staff is friendly and didn't try to over or upsell. Took my truck in for an alignment and inspection and they had it done in an hour. Not to mention they are very reasonably priced. I highly recommend them and will be going back for anything I can't take care of myself.

reviews.author: samuel parral
reviews.text: Cody and Tyrell are top notch dudes that are willing to help anyway they can! I have been coming here for a long time and they never disappoint and their mechanics are really good guys as well They are very honest and with affordable prices Thank you guys for being amazing

reviews.author: Dale Badgett
reviews.text: Needed an inspection, oil change, tires rotated and rear brake pads.Tyrell explained everything clearing and had it all done when promised and at a reasonable price. Great job!

reviews.author: Rebekah
reviews.text: I was experiencing a tire issue on a cross country trip and stopped in to Parrish. They got me in quickly and assessed the problem. Good work, welcoming folks and honest pricing. Thank you Tyrell and the team at Parrish Tire!

reviews.author: Ethereal Justice
reviews.text: I called early and they said come right over. The price was fair and they found my tires were balding on the front. And they weren't pushy about it but just let me know. I'd definitely go back again for all my oil changing needs.

reviews.author: Amanda Draughn
reviews.text: Excellent customer service!!! They found the problem and fixed a problem that three previous mechanics could not. Very thankful and appreciative!!!

reviews.author: Dirk Cheek
reviews.text: Dropped off Monday no appointment on a skip and a few other small items ready the next day with only a small vacuum leak repaired. Great job guys! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Derrick Stoltzfus
reviews.text: We got two of our Ranger tires replaced here. I was very impressed with the professional tire service that Parrish provided. The shop is cleaned up with everything in its place and the staff is knowledgeable and professional.

reviews.author: Alex Kirkman
reviews.text: I have been using them for the past year and these guys are always polite and prompt when it comes to servicing my vehicle. Not only is this Parrish Tire close by my work, making it super convenient to drop off/pick up during my shift; they are fast, get the job done, and are flexible with working me in last minute.

reviews.author: Melissa Stewart
reviews.text: My daughter was on her way cross country to college in PA from FL. Within her first two hours her car broke down and it had taken two days (and a lot of $) for my husband to fix so she (and I) was already stressed to the max. Today, 3.5 hours into day two of her trip (it’s only supposed to take 16 hours to get to PA from FL), she got a flat tire. We had roadside come put the spare tire on and I began calling tire shops. One of the places I called said they couldn’t help me because they were commercial but the BEST place to go was Parrish! I called the first Parrish I could find which was in Winston-Salem. He was not the right shop but as soon as I told him my predicament and that I believed my daughter was near Dobson, he immediately looked up the number and address to their Dobson location. So helpful!!! Once I called this location I spoke with Tyrell and he was above and beyond exceptional to us! I cannot put into words how much of a nightmare this trip has been and to have someone so kind, helpful, honest and really just someone who made sure our daughter was taken care of...Well...in this world, there are angels and God brings them across our path for a reason. Thank you so much for making sure our daughter could get back on the road today and safely (and it didn’t break the bank)!!! You deserve an award!

reviews.author: Rí Stroupe
reviews.text: Today my significant other and I were driving through North Carolina from Georgia, heading to Connecticut for her fathers funeral tomorrow. As you can imagine we aren’t in the highest of spirits. We noticed that our tire pressure went down and stopped by Parrish. Nervous and stressed they welcomed us kindly and assisted us to the best of our ability. Even to the point of calling around to other places bc we needed a new wheel since ours ended up being cracked. We purchased the tires that they had and headed out to where they helped us find wheels. I say that to say that they’re not the selfish repair services that say whatever to get you to spend money or mislead you. They genuinely helped knowing we know nothing about cats or the area. We appreciate this more than they can imagine. You guys were angels today and I’m sure any other day as well. Service was fast. Cost was appropriate Thank you Cody Hiatt .(and the other guy but I don’t have his name.)

reviews.author: Kirk Killon
reviews.text: Always professional and friendly crew. I have been a customer for many years. Parrish Tire is a great place for automotive repairs as well as the top notch tire service.

reviews.author: Travis Melcher
reviews.text: Definitely a great place to get tires. I somehow got a huge cut in my sidewall. Try were able to have a matching tire ordered and installed for me in no time

reviews.author: Karen Lowe
reviews.text: I’ve always been happy with Parrish Tire in Dobson! They provide excellent, knowledgeable and friendly service every time. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my car!

reviews.author: Deborah Cave
reviews.text: Everyone was professional and my car was ready on time. No complaints! I have used them in the past and will use them in the future. Cody is very good to work with!

reviews.author: Isabelle Scantland Lebel
reviews.text: These guys are incredibly honest and helpful! We were traveling from Florida back to Canada and had a major issue with the camper van's transmission. We stopped by only 10 min before they closed and they accepted to help us out anyway. On top of that they only charged for the cost of the oil!

reviews.author: Stephen Dee
reviews.text: While traveling out of town, we found that one of our tires had a slow leak. We stopped at this shop and fortunately were able to get the repair that got us back on the road! The staff was very helpful, knowledgeable, and friendly. Whether you’re passing through, or live in the area, you should stop here for any tire issues!

reviews.author: Barbara Adams
reviews.text: My 22 year old daughter and her best friend were on their way home to Pittsburgh, Pa when our car broke down and needed a new alternator and battery. These guys took such good care of my daughter and safely got them back on the road. A couple days later the alternator was defective and we had the expense of paying for another one. We notified Parrish Tire and they could not have been more sympathetic. They reimbursed us and reminded us that there are good garages out there that do the right thing. Thank you so much for taking care of my daughter when we felt so helpless being so far away from her

reviews.author: Andrea Poindexter
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Parish Tire. I was needing an inspection, and Cody offered great customer service. He told me to come by and everything went very smoothly.

reviews.author: Jennifer Rinker
reviews.text: My daughters tire blew out on I-77. She was able to make it to Parrish tire. They were very patient with my very nervous daughter. I felt like they were very honest! They never pushed us to buy more than were needed. I really appreciate not only the tire service but how kind they were to my daughter. If I lived in the area I would use them for everything!

reviews.author: denise ward
reviews.text: Great service! Needed reasonably priced set of tires , not cheap, and got them with confidence. Great local service, just what I needed and preferred.

reviews.author: James Hewitt
reviews.text: I needed 2 new tires for my JD Lawn Tractor so I went to Parrish Tire in Dobson. Due to it being late in the mowing season they had no tires in stock but they ordered them for me. This was on a Friday and the tires came in on Monday. They called me as soon as the tires arrived and when I got there they proceeded to change the tires while I waited. I was very pleased with their prompt service and the courtesy and professionalism shown by the manager.

reviews.author: Connie Vaughan
reviews.text: Parrish Tire in Dobson is the only place I take my vehicles. I recommend them anytime I can and everyone thanks me! Tyrell, the manager is so nice, knowledgeable and listens to your concerns. He makes sure everything is checked out thourougly, and will get you in for an emergency when needed.

reviews.author: Michael Wall
reviews.text: Top of the line service every time. I have bought 12-15 sets of tires over the years. They do the service on my light cars and trucks. Cody and Tyrell go out of their way to help.

reviews.author: George Welte
reviews.text: I had a blow out on Good Friday afternoon 4/02/21 on I-77 about 14 Miles from this store. There were other stores closer but all had closed early on this day. After I changed your on road to donut tire, with300+ Miles to go, I called Parish Tire and they were still open. I drove there, they took my tire, found out only a previous "plug" got blown out and repaired tire within 15 minutes! I was very impressed on their professional abilities, protocol with me as a customer, and just good business relationship with other customers as I waited. I'm very thankful for their efforts, I even tipped as I would any other service business.

reviews.author: Robert Mason
reviews.text: Was supposed to have an alignment done. I had rebuilt the steering system with all new ball joints, inner and outer tie rods. Went for an alignment and was in the shop with the so called mechanic while he was performing said alignment. Everything was bad according to him, I explained it was all new parts and just needed tightening up. No go, wouldn't turn a bolt, wouldn't remove the knockouts for adjusting caster and camber. Only thing that was adjusted was the toe in. It was worse when I left than when I drove it in. $90 for them to do basically nothing. Called them when I left and told the manager about it being worse, emailed the home office with a complaint and nothing. So now I wouldn't trust them to check the air in my tires. Highly Not Recommended, nothing but a bunch of hacks!

reviews.author: Teresa Odell
reviews.text: Tyrrell was so nice. I will do business with Dobson Parrish Tire again. Great deal on my new four tires. "Excellent customer service. "

reviews.author: Sudha Kutty
reviews.text: HONESTY AT ITS BEST!! We were on a vacation in Dobson when we got a flat tire. Called Parrish early in the morning to see if they carried the tire for our car. Cody answered the phone, and checked and let me know that it was readily available. He even told me what the approximate price would be, so that there were no surprises. But guess what!!! When I went in with my car, I had the biggest surprise of my life. Cody came back after checking the tire to let me know that I didn't need a new tire. That they could repair the tire! And the price came to 1/10th of the original estimate!!! I was given an update every few minutes to let me know the status. We were out of the service center within less than an hour and happily on our way home. I truly wish that I had Parrish/Cody in the state I live in!!! Special thanks to Cody! Cody equals Customer service par excellence!!! What more can I say!

reviews.author: Ethan Simmons
reviews.text: First time coming here, won’t be the last. Got me in quickly, and let me know of the issues as they came across them. Very easy to work with, and efficient.

reviews.author: larry hill
reviews.text: Had an engine oil leak in a couple of places, was given a good estimate for repairs. Work was professionally done and I am well pleased. Thanks Cody and Crew!

reviews.author: Diane Miller
reviews.text: We were heading north on 77 pulling our 5th wheel RV and our diesel truck suddenly lost power and check engine light came on. Able to get onto the ramp off 77 at Zephyr Rd. Dropped our RV at a lot nearby, local at the DQ told us Dobson was 4 mile away with garages. First one we called couldn't accommodate us, too busy, at first no answer at Parrish so we decide to just go there, glad we did! Friendly helpful mechanic checked our codes, gave his opinion, had us test drive the truck a few miles and then rechecked the codes again, everything was ok. Probably dirt in fuel triggered a code. He didn't charge us anything when we asked how much his service was! Told us to have a good day! Coming from the Philly suburbs nothing is free! Appreciate his help more than he knows. Wish I'd gotten his name.

reviews.author: Sherry White
reviews.text: Parrish Tire & Automotive in Dobson has always been great at getting me & my husband’s vehicles taken care of efficiently and they do a great job! All of the employees are friendly as well!

reviews.author: Jerry Gauvin
reviews.text: Had a recent tire issue and Parrish Tire handled it in a timely manner and the price was right. This has been the case several times over the years. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Scott Miller
reviews.text: This is how auto repairs and service SHOULD BE! Smart, senior mechanics who do excellent work, knowledgeable service techs who know how to work with and properly treat customers, and fair pricing for great, quality work!

reviews.author: George Golding
reviews.text: Parrish Tire in Dobson has always did a great job. They take the time to explain what ever they may be working on and any thing that they fine while working on the vehicle. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Doug Dixon
reviews.text: The team at Parrish Tire in Dobson is very courteous, professional and willing to help. I definitely recommend them for your automotive needs!

reviews.author: kevin burcham
reviews.text: Fixed two rear wheel bearings. Got it all done in one day.. kept the car a few days for my daughter to arrange pic up. Great to work with ad always.

reviews.author: Trae Edwards
reviews.text: Would just like to give a thank you to Tim and Zach for doing an outstanding job getting my tires mounted up on my high end wheels. They took extra care in making sure the wheels didn’t get scratched while doing the work. Thank you guy will be back

reviews.author: Teddy Edwards
reviews.text: Great service I needed a tractor tire Ty had it in and ready next day. I really thought it would take a couple of days. The price was good would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Christy johnson
reviews.text: Great customer service. I got tires and thought I needed brakes. They told me my brakes were good. They could have as easily told me they were bad. Honest people.

reviews.author: Lyra Smitherman
reviews.text: I called because of noise in the front end. I belive it was on the breaks. They got me in the next day . I had ask to be let know what was being fixed and the price which was done.. All in a timely and considerate manner with the upmost professionalism. Will recommend and use again.

reviews.author: Kevin Burcham
reviews.text: Have a 7.3 diesel F350 dually. Had injectors replaced and transmission. It runs way better! Definitely will let them rebuilt my Excursion 7.3 when it needs it. Thank you Brandon, Tyrell and all the Parrish crew.

reviews.author: William Crouse
reviews.text: Parrish Tire in Dobson is great! It all starts with Tyrell Easter. He is knowledgeable, respectful, hardworking person I know. Trust him with any job needed done to my vehicle.

reviews.author: Tyler Ramey
reviews.text: Highly recommended Parrish Tire in Dobson, walked out to my car at work with 2 flat tires and got it over to Parrish, they set me up with 4 new tires in a professional and timely manor, would recommend them to anyone in the area.

reviews.author: Lynn Crouse
reviews.text: Parrish Tire in Dobson is a great place for tires, tire repair and general automotive repair. Generally don’t send reviews but Parrish needs recognition for the reliable work they do. Timely and no need return for any work not completed the first time.

reviews.author: leah york
reviews.text: Great place with even better employees! Brandon is always so nice and finds time to work me in on a short notice. Bobby is always my mechanic and does an amazing job. Never been disappointed with this place!

reviews.author: Angel Jones
reviews.text: The employees at the Dobson location are very friendly and knowledgeable. I live in Cana, VA and make the trip to Dobson because of this.

reviews.author: Adam Simpson
reviews.text: The team at Parrish Tire in Dobson North Carolina is fast efficient and great at what they do. I appreciate all of your hard work guys. Keep it up.

reviews.author: Tim Mason
reviews.text: Great team. Very helpful. Got a great set of tires. They worked with our schedule and got the work done quickly

reviews.author: Chad Draughn
reviews.text: Dropped off truck explained issue. Picked up later had been corrected. Great experience all the way around.

reviews.author: Russell B
reviews.text: The guys here are very accommodating and very knowledgeable. Best place Ive been to ever for your automotive needs. This is where I take all my vehicles & recommend them to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Sarah Carson
reviews.text: Brandon Collins is the most honest, dependable & friendly person we have ever dealt with! We can ALWAYS count on Brandon to help us with our tire needs and he never fails to gets us exactly what we are looking for! Thanks Brandon!! Sarah Carson

reviews.author: Kayla Beck (BloodRayne61)
reviews.text: Took my truck for a safety inspection and they tried to tell me it wouldn't pass because it's straight piped. That's no illegal in Surry county. Then they kept my registration card and never gave it back. Absolutely worse place to go.

reviews.author: Nancy Pugh
reviews.text: On the way to work one morning, my tire went flat......while I was driving! I made to Parrish Tire, Dobson, which was about a block from my job. Explained the situation to them. They gave me a ride to work and started on my car. A couple of hours later, they called me, to tell me it was ready, and oh yea, by the way, they found tires that was a better deal and lowered the cost. They were very professional, and a godsend that day!

reviews.author: Bridgette Browder
reviews.text: I just want to take a minute and say "thank you" to Brandon Collins for making me feel like he's going to make everything okay with my van, I travel with my family daily on the roads and to know that there is someone out there to assure me everything will be okay to the best of their ability, makes me smile!!! Thanks Parish for your manager, Brandon!

reviews.author: Heather Forestieri
reviews.text: Wonderful people, great service. They’ve always been quick to help and very reasonable and honest. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: David Jones
reviews.text: Great place to get your car worked on. Fast and reliable and never tries to upsale you on things you don’t need. Trust them with all my cars.

reviews.author: John Cooper
reviews.text: Courteous, professional and affordable service. They had my vehicle fixed and back on the road in about an hour.

reviews.author: your local neighbor meme dealer
reviews.text: Normally don't do Google reviews but tbh think they deserve it, guy at the front desk was chill, they had good pricing, and they work quick. 10/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Ross Scott
reviews.text: Parrish Tire was extremely helpful. They were responsive to our needs in a quick and efficient manner.

reviews.author: Jersey Badd
reviews.text: Bad customer service. I believe they are biased. I've walked in here plenty of times just to observe how they speak to people. And walked out. Today was the day for me to test that theory and I was quite impressed. God is watching everyone. Be blessed.

reviews.author: Joe Conner
reviews.text: I went for a tire balance and a wheel alignment and all the staff was friendly, honest, and made me feel welcome..first time there and i will be back again..thanks for the exceptional service.

reviews.author: David Worden
reviews.text: Such a solid team! Cody and the team at Parrish Tire & Automotive have always been fair, friendly, and understanding.

reviews.author: Jill Kyles
reviews.text: Always super friendly! Always taken care of! Great work! We won't take our cars anywhere else! Highly! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chaz Watson
reviews.text: Good shop. Reasonable prices. Like that the provide recommendations for services (transmissions) that they don't do.

reviews.author: Lucas Gillispie
reviews.text: Friendly and affordable with great customer service. Always happy to have the folks at Parrish working on our vehicles.

reviews.author: Dale Sisson
reviews.text: Great service. Showed me what they found and explained it all to me. Did a great job on the alignment. Great folks!

reviews.author: Amanda Killon-Atwood
reviews.text: These guys are amazing! I work at the college and they always take me to work and pick me up so I never have to wait for my car to be serviced.

reviews.author: Vicky Galyean
reviews.text: Always have great experience at Parrish Tire in Dobson. They treat you with respect and and do not do anything without letting you know first what the problem is. Love these guys!!!

reviews.author: Ashlee Shaw
reviews.text: This was my 1st and last visit. I was charged $110.86 for a basic oil change and an air filter. Not understanding why I was charged so much, the answer I received was a stare and a receipt.

reviews.author: Scott Axtell
reviews.text: I work hard for my money and when I found out over the weekend I got ripped off by Parrish Tire where the business I work for took their vehicles to get worked on I was highly disappointed. I was charged $214.00 for a job that wasn't done; I was showed by another shop that what I paid for wasn't done/changed out. It's a shame there are people/companies out there that still take advantage of people.

reviews.author: Sheri Haymore
reviews.text: Parrish Tire in Dobson, NC, has taken care of my vehicles for many years. I've trusted them with my tire needs, vehicle maintenance, and the rare repairs they've suggested.

reviews.author: Teresa Smith
reviews.text: They are wonderful at customer service and did a great job replacing 2 tire sensors and rotating my tires. They did this in a very timely manner.

reviews.author: Chris Heath
reviews.text: Great place in our small town. An oil change or inspection or even installing an engine that went bad, they can do it. Great folks. Thanks a lot.

reviews.author: Rick Shelton
reviews.text: Fast, friendly service for everything from tires to brakes to inspections and oil changes. Our local one stop shop for all of our automotive needs.

reviews.author: Suzanne Collins
reviews.text: Would not consider going anywhere else for all of our car care needs. Best service, best prices, professional service. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Rhonda Hooker
reviews.text: They are friendly and get to know you. I have not been disappointed in any service they have provided. Awesome team that works there.

reviews.author: Terrea Wall
reviews.text: They have always taken care of us when we go in for any kind of service. Very knowledgeable Great group of guys.

reviews.author: Kayla Lindsay Atkins
reviews.text: I wouldn’t even think about going somewhere else! They are fast knowledgeable and trustworthy! Tyrell and Brandon are I give y’all 5 stars and more if I could!!!

reviews.author: Peter Templeton
reviews.text: Always pleasant and professional. They make repairs and charge fairly for what they do and what they sell. Work is always done right the first time.

reviews.author: Brad Mondie
reviews.text: They were very accommodating to my specific problem and they were very reasonable with their prices - 5 stars all the way!

reviews.author: Drew
reviews.text: Super fast service at good prices! Squeezed in putting rear brake pads on when I dropped by! Great shop for car service!

reviews.author: Roy Ferguson
reviews.text: Great company that checked out my electrical system for no charge. Said they could not find any issues. I have gone there for years.

reviews.author: tim lakey
reviews.text: I have always had a great experience with Parrish Tire and highly recommend them. They give great service.

reviews.author: Wayne Chambers
reviews.text: Came recommended by my father. I was not disappointed. Their work was efficient and prompt. Prices were fair. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Annett Holyfield
reviews.text: They were very friendly and helped you in a timely manner kept there app. Time with me they are are a hard working bunch of men there in Dobson N.C.

reviews.author: David Vernon
reviews.text: Parrish Tire does a great job with my tires, state inspection, oil change and more. I don't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Keith Wilmoth
reviews.text: They always take care of my vehicles & have never had a problem! Being using them for years and have 5 vehicles.

reviews.author: Tim Lakey
reviews.text: They offer great service and great prices. They are always very friendly and attentive to what you need.

reviews.author: Scottie Pierce
reviews.text: Have done several repairs and maintenance on several of my vehicles. Great job, timely, fair pricing.

reviews.author: Janet Sosnowski
reviews.text: Nice people, good work, honest and comparable prices. This is at the DOBSON store, I will NEVER return to to Mt Airy store.

reviews.author: Josh Addington
reviews.text: This place is AWESOME! All the guys there are super nice and courteous. They had me in and out in no time! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Scotty Bullins
reviews.text: Good folks at PTC. They helped me make some decisions that saved me money on my vehicle. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Kristian J
reviews.text: These guys are pure gold. It's great to find a shop which won't try to get one over on you. Very highly recommended.

reviews.author: patricia fowler
reviews.text: Very nice fellows,they are very good honest people.They will let you know what you need on car or truck.

reviews.author: Peter Volk
reviews.text: Great i even bought the mechanic lunch they fixed a bad oil leak Hard to find good mechanic around here i will be going back.

reviews.author: Tanda Fleek
reviews.text: Traveling on Interstate 77 when we got a flat. Excellent service and they got us back on road pronto
